nom: SkinMedica Retinol Serum 0.25 Complex - Serum for Face

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally tolerate it well and recommend easing in slowly — starting with once a week and pairing with a rich moisturizer — with one reviewer warning that sensitive skin should especially avoid the stronger 1.0 strength or risk burning and peeling.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin, including acne scars and sun marks, reports a firmer, smoother look within just one week, though she suggests sensitive skin take breaks between applications given how fast it acts.
segments.mature: The reviewer in her late 40s with fine lines and sun damage reports strong results and no irritation, saying it works as well as or better than prescription retinoids she's tried.

concerns.aging: This is the product's most consistently reported benefit: reviewers describe fewer fine lines, relaxed forehead creases, smaller-looking pores, and a firmer, tighter look, in some cases after just one or two applications.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports daily use dried out her face with some peeling at first, though the effects resolved after the initial adjustment period; using a rich moisturizer alongside it is commonly recommended.
concerns.redness: Redness and burning are commonly reported in the first days or weeks, especially with the stronger 1.0% strength or if used too often too soon; multiple reviewers say this subsides with continued, less frequent use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her overall skin tone became noticeably more even after a few weeks of use, alongside smaller-looking pores.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with no prior history of acne reports developing small breakouts after starting retinol, which she understands to be a common initial reaction to the ingredient.

aspects.libelle: Risk of counterfeit, expired or diluted product from third-party sellers
Some report receiving the wrong strength than ordered
Small amount needed per use, bottle lasts a long time
Considered expensive but worth it for the results
Must be used only at night with daily sunscreen
Pump dispenses a precise, small dose

extraits.texte: I ordered this product back in August after seeing such great reviews on various sites. Well I’ve been using it about 4 months now and haven’t noticed much of anything. I go to the actual Skinmedica site to view other products when I see they’ve released a statement. They are warning consumers not to purchase any of their products from Amazon and several other sites. They say the products being sold are either defaulted, expired, or diluted. I know I can’t prove if it’s been diluted or if it’s a faulty product but I decide to check the dates. I go check my box it says 2016. I check the bottle it says 2014. That’s 3 years old. It doesn’t make much sense that the bottle and box would have separate dates. I’m really upset and I wish I would’ve known sooner since the return window time has been closed. But I’d hate to see anyone else waste their money. You can read the article on the SkinMedica website.

extraits.titre: Burns my skin & leaves it red
extraits.texte: This is my first ever retinol purchase. I have very good skin and I purchased this for anti-aging purposes. I followed the instructions knowing about the potential side effects. My skin turned red and was burning for a while. I learned that the skin closer to my nose and mouth is extra sensitive and so I try to avoid it as much as possible. I’ve also noticed that I’m starting to get some small zits (I’ve never had any acne issue) but I read that this is common with retinol. I haven’t been using it for long enough to see a difference or notice its effect but I can say that the more I use it, the less redness and burning.

extraits.titre: Seems expensive, but I took a chance and am very pleased with this product.
extraits.texte: Expensive, but worth the price. I have found it difficult to find an over the counter retinol product that works. This seems effective. I found that using it daily did dry my face and I had some minor peeling, but after that initial phase those effects resolved. I have fairly sensitive skin and I am tolerating it well. I do use a good moisturizer. If it seems to irritating starting with applications less frequently, as most retinol products recommend, should help ease your skin into it. The pump dispenses a small drop per pump and that is enough for my face and neck. I will purchase this again, although this bottle should last quite a while given the small amount used for each application.

I’ve bought this several times. I’m 47 and have all the fine lines and sun damage. It’s definitely strong! I recommend using once a week at first if you haven’t used retinol before. No irritation and I just apply a thin layer of lotion before and after application. Works just as well or better than prescription. I’ve used retinol and trentoin and this is my favorite

extraits.titre: Great product. Don't  think it twice  to get it.
extraits.texte: I was using the .5 and started with the 1.0 just a week ago. I can see the difference in just one week. I have mix skin with acne scars and sun marks. Skin got softly peeled and already got a firmer and smoother look. I highly recommend but judging for it's immediate action I would say to take breaks for sensitive skins in between usage. For the rest this product is high quality. Highly recommended.

I’ve been using SkinMedica Retinol 1.0 for several months and the results are impressive. This is definitely the best retinol you can buy without prescription. Best for people who already have experience with retinoids, not recommended for beginners . The first days I had some redness and flaking, which is normal for a 1.0% retinol. After few weeks of using my skin looked much smoother, pores appeared smaller, and my overall tone became more even. I use it only at night with a rich moisturizer. You must use sunscreen daily
